Slayer’s Oath’s mechanics select one enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE at battle round 1 and let this unit ignore WS, BS and Hit modifiers against it. The notes instead trigger saga rewards after destroying a unit with a chosen keyword. Check the oath selection and reward.
Your army cannot include APOTHECARIES.
This unit’s weapons gain Sustained Hits 1. Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 against targets within 6″.
In your Shooting phase, if not Battle-shocked, roll a D6; on 1 this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Select one visible enemy within 18″; it suffers -1 to Hit until the start of the next turn.
In a turn when this unit charged, improve its melee Strength and Damage by 1.
If this model has an entirely melee loadout, this unit’s melee weapons gain Twin-linked.

War Howl gives BLOOD CLAWS +1 melee Strength and Sustained Hits 1 while this model is attached. Its charge-after-Advance clause also requires attachment to HEADTAKERS/WOLF GUARD inside the BLOOD CLAWS condition, making the eligibility contradictory. Check which unit gets each benefit.
This unit’s ranged weapons gain Assault. When it Advances, you may treat its Advance roll as 6.
Add 2 to the bearer’s Wounds and improve its melee Strength by 1.
Once per turn for this unit, after an enemy shoots and hits it in your opponent’s Shooting phase, it may make a D3+1″ Surge move.
After an enemy shoots at the selected ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit, that unit can make a D3+3″ Normal move.
This unit can charge after Advancing.

When a friendly ASKAR’S WOLFPACK WULFEN unit destroys an enemy, Bestial Dominance grants +1 OC for the battle. The source assigns it to the rule’s own unit rather than explicitly to the destroying WULFEN unit, and omits whether it accumulates.
Birth of a Saga grants CHARACTER to this unit until your next Command phase, but does not state when it is used or whether only one model receives the keyword.
After an enemy Falls Back from the eligible non-TERMINATOR ASKAR’S WOLFPACK unit, your unit can make a D3+1″ Normal move if now unengaged.
When the eligible ASKAR’S WOLFPACK unit fights, its melee weapons gain Anti-MONSTER 4+ and Anti-VEHICLE 4+ for the phase.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit fights, it can re-roll melee Hit and Wound rolls of 1 for the phase.
After deployment, you may redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units or place them into Strategic Reserves, ignoring normal reserve limits.
The bearer can re-roll melee Hit rolls of 1.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit attacks, it can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for the phase.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit fights, its melee weapons gain Precision for the phase.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or WALKER unit is selected to move or declares charge targets, it gains MOBILE for the phase.
Grimnar’s Command selects a Combat Doctrine for the unit until your next Command phase, replacing its army-wide doctrine. The source does not state when it can be activated.
Once per battle round for your army, this unit can use Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention even if already used that phase. That use costs 1CP less and does not consume the shared use limit.
In your Shooting phase, choose up to one visible enemy within 6″ and roll a D6. On 2+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds, or 2D3 if it is a VEHICLE.
When an enemy targets the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit, reduce those attacks’ Damage by 1 until the attack sequence ends.
Reduce friendly ASKAR’S WOLFPACK units’ detection range by 3″.
Once per turn for this unit, at the start of the Fight phase, choose one enemy within 6″ of the bearer. It takes a Battle-shock test at -1.
After deployment, you may redeploy up to three friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN units, or place them into Strategic Reserves ignoring normal reserve limits.
After an enemy shoots at the selected unit, that unit can make a D6″ Surge move.
Friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY and WULFEN gain Lethal Hits against CHARACTER, MONSTER and VEHICLE targets.
The bearer gains Lone Operative with a 9″ range, Stealth and +1 Toughness.

Eligible non-MONSTER/non-VEHICLE units gain doctrine bonuses: Assault gives +1 Advance/Charge; Devastator re-rolls ranged Hit rolls of 1; Tactical gives Sustained Hits 1 against targets within 9″. Once per battle Logan can extend these to MONSTERS/VEHICLES until your next Command phase. The eligibility requires the Master of Wolves ability itself, but the source does not identify which units receive it.
When declaring battle formations, you may split this unit into two equal units.
Enemies that are neither MONSTERS nor VEHICLES must use Desperate Escape when Falling Back from this unit. Apply -1 to those tests if they are Battle-shocked.
Set this model’s Wounds to 6.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER units gain Countercharge: once per battle round for each unit, Heroic Intervention targeting it costs 1CP less.
When damage is allocated to the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit, it gains Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds for the phase.
The bearer’s unit gains WULFEN and +2″ Move.
While this unit is not Battle-shocked and within 6″ of a non-WULFEN SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER or 12″ of a WOLF PRIEST, its INFANTRY models gain +1 OC and its VEHICLE models gain +3 OC.

This model is Psyker Level 3. Spend 1 Psychic Level for a phase of reduced detection range when targeted, or in your Shooting phase to suppress a visible enemy within 18″ until the next turn starts. Each power rolls a D6; 1 causes Battle-shock. Its Movement-phase power encodes “cannot shoot as if Snap Shooting”; check whether it prohibits Snap Shots or shooting entirely.
Add 1 to this unit’s OC while it is not Battle-shocked and within 6″ of a non-WULFEN SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model.
At the start of each battle round, gain 1CP if your Warlord has this ability.
When the eligible BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN unit fights, its melee weapons gain Lance for the phase.
The bearer has a 2+ Save and Feel No Pain 5+.
If your army includes MARNEUS CALGAR, choose one Combat Doctrine option that can be selected one additional time.
Oath of Macragge gives the bearer +1 melee Strength, or +2 while Assault Doctrine is active. Its AP change is encoded as an addition rather than an improvement; check the intended AP sign.

After an enemy moves within 8″ of unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED, Practical Tactics grants a D3+3″ Normal move. It assigns that move to the rule’s own unit rather than the nearby eligible unit; check the recipient.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is targeted, subtract 1 from incoming Wound rolls if attack Strength exceeds target Toughness. Lasts for the phase.
Ultramarian Adaptivity selects a Combat Doctrine for the unit until your next Command phase, replacing its army-wide doctrine. The source does not state when it is activated.
The bearer’s ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.

Adaptive Defence grants re-rolls of Hit and Wound rolls of 1 when the attacking unit is within terrain. The source explicitly omits the separate conditional ENTRENCHED benefit and its condition, so the full detachment rule is incomplete.
Select an eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit before it shoots. Choose Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1 for the phase; an Entrenched unit can gain both instead.

Castellum Omnivox allows actions after an Advance or Fall Back in the mechanics, but its notes only mention Falling Back and choosing an unspecified option for the turn. Check the available options, trigger and duration.

After deployment, redeploy up to three units or place them into Strategic Reserves ignoring reserve limits. The mechanics restrict this to ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY while the notes allow any ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit; check eligibility.
After an enemy shoots at the eligible INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit, it can make a D6″ Normal move. If Entrenched, it may re-roll that move distance.
The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll a D6 at phase end; on 2+ it returns unengaged near where it died. The notes give full wounds while the mechanics give 3; check its returned wounds.
Select an eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit before it shoots or fights. Add 1 to Wound rolls against MONSTERS and VEHICLES for the phase.
The bearer’s unit’s ranged weapons gain Ignores Cover.

Stand To The End has unrelated effects: its notes allow destroyed models to fight on 4+, with +1 if Entrenched, but the mechanics instead reduce incoming Wound rolls. Check the actual defensive effect.
Select one eligible unit in Engagement Range of enemies. Add 1 to its OC for the turn.
When eligible Entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY consolidate, they may choose an objective-focused mode. The source does not supply that mode’s distance and ending-position requirements.

Adept of the Omnissiah’s notes change an incoming attack’s Damage to 0 after a nearby VEHICLE fails a save, once per battle round. The mechanics instead give Feel No Pain 5+ when targeted. Check the actual effect and trigger.
Until your next Command phase, the selected WALKER gains +1″ Move, +1 Toughness, improved Leadership by 1, +1 OC and +1 to Hit.

Armoured Wrath allows a single Hit, Wound or Damage re-roll, with all three near CAANOK VAR or IRON FATHER FEIRROS. The notes say once per phase but the mechanics give a fresh allowance whenever selected to shoot or fight; check the shared usage limit.

Target Augury Web grants Lethal Hits until your next Command phase, but its notes select a VEHICLE within 6″ in the Command phase while the mechanics select one within 3″ during movement. Check the phase, distance and trigger.
The bearer gains +1 Toughness and Feel No Pain 5+.

Unbowed Conviction’s notes let a unit below Starting Strength ignore characteristic and roll/test modifiers except saving throws. The mechanics omit that strength condition and only cover WS, BS, Hit and Wound rolls. Check the full scope.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE is destroyed, automatically trigger its Deadly Demise instead of rolling, treating the result as 6.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit attacks, its weapons gain Sustained Hits 1 for the phase. If it is a VEHICLE, also add 1 to its Wound rolls.
After an enemy shoots at the selected ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE, it may shoot back using Snap Shooting, or Normal shooting if at or below Half-strength. It must target that attacking enemy.
When damage is allocated to the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit, it gains Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds for the phase.

In your Movement phase, choose one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE within 6″ of the bearer. Activate Devastator or Tactical Doctrine for it until your next Command phase, replacing its army-wide doctrine.
The bearer’s unit gains Infiltrators.
Enemy units in Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit that are neither MONSTERS nor VEHICLES cannot be targeted with Stratagems.
Feint and Thrust activates Tactical Doctrine for this unit until your next Command phase, but does not state when it can be used.

Hunter’s Instincts’ notes treat the battle round as one higher when the bearer’s unit arrives from Strategic Reserves. Its mechanics only allow an Ingress move in battle round 1. Check the full arrival permission.

After an enemy moves within 8″ of unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY, a D6″ Normal move is offered, or 6″ for PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD. The source assigns the move to the rule’s own unit rather than the nearby eligible unit; check the recipient.
The bearer gains Fights First and Lone Operative.
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES gain Stealth; PHOBOS and SCOUT SQUADS also reduce detection range by 3″. AETHON SHAAN gains a once-per-battle-round army-wide discount of 1CP on Into Darkness.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit shoots in a turn when it made an Ingress move, improve its ranged BS and AP by 1 for the phase.
After the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit shoots, those attacks do not end its Hidden state.
Reduce Damage allocated to the bearer by 1. For Melta or Torrent attacks, instead set their Damage to 1.
At the start of your opponent’s Charge phase, choose one visible enemy within 12″. Subtract 1 from its Charge rolls for the phase.

After an enemy shoots at the selected TRANSPORT, one embarked unit can disembark as if it were your Movement phase and shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. It must target only that enemy, if eligible.
Select an eligible INFANTRY unit before it shoots or fights. Add 1 to Wound rolls against its closest eligible target within 6″ for the phase.

Forged in Battle has unrelated effects in the source: ignoring WS, BS and Hit modifiers in the mechanics, but changing one Hit roll or saving throw to an unmodified 6 once per turn in the notes. Check the actual benefit.
Select an eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit before it shoots. Improve its Torrent ranged weapons’ AP by 1 for the phase.
Add 1 to the Attacks of the bearer’s unit’s Torrent ranged weapons.

Select Devastator Doctrine one additional time. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES ranged attacks gain +1 Strength against targets within 12″. If your army includes VULKAN HE’STAN, INFERNUS SQUADS can start actions after Advancing or Falling Back and shoot while performing them. Your army must use SALAMANDERS and a single chapter.
Improve the bearer’s melee Strength and Damage by 1.
When the eligible engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit shoots, its Torrent weapons lose Blast, gain Close Quarters and gain +1 Attack for the phase.
Wrath and Ruin activates Assault or Tactical Doctrine until your next Command phase, replacing the unit’s army-wide doctrine. The source does not state when it can be used.
When the bearer’s unit arrives by Ingress, treat the battle round as one higher for its setup.
The bearer’s unit’s ranged weapons gain Ignores Cover and Sustained Hits 1.

After an enemy moves within 8″ of unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY, MOUNTED or SPEEDER, Hunter’s Instincts grants a D3+3″ Normal move. The source assigns it to the rule’s own unit rather than the nearby eligible unit; check the recipient.

When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit Advances or Falls Back, it gains Assault on ranged weapons and permission to shoot after Falling Back. The source ends both at phase end, before normal shooting; check the intended duration.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit fights, choose Lethal Hits or Lance for its melee weapons for the phase. A MOUNTED unit gains both instead.
The bearer gains +1 melee Strength, or +2 in a turn when it charged. Spearpoint Paragon encodes its matching AP change as an addition rather than an improvement; check the AP sign.

Choose Assault or Tactical Doctrine to use one additional time. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units gain +1 Advance. At Fight phase end, SUBODEN KHAN’s unit can make a Normal move if unengaged or Fall Back if engaged, provided eligible to fight. Your army must use WHITE SCARS and a single chapter.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit is targeted, subtract 1 from incoming ranged Wound rolls for the phase.
When the eligible ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is selected to move or declares charge targets, it gains MOBILE for the phase.
